summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of OLI Employee Panel prototype covering all 6 bugs. All 19 individual assertions passed. No auto-redirect after Complete (URL remains on /yet-to-work with success banner). Complete section renders with correct row + expandable detail + sidebar badge (count 1). All Call Schedule shows only OLI ID / Customer / Call Date / Call Time / Status / Action (no completion info). Timer freezes correctly on both Pause and Complete (5s wait held elapsed at 00:02). Frozen elapsed persists into Priority page (00:02) and Completed Filings time-taken (00:02, green). Standalone /employee/live-work route removed - falls back to Dashboard; no sidebar-live-work entry.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is a single 469-line file — acceptable for prototype but should be split into components/ per screen if the app grows.
completedAt uses toLocaleTimeString/DateString; timezone-dependent display. Fine for demo, may need normalization for production.
Draft file object stores only fileName (no actual upload) — correct for a client-only prototype.
seed_data_creation: None — localStorage cleared before each scenario; app self-seeds 10 TMR items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 bug fixes are verified working end-to-end via Playwright. Test flow: clear localStorage, start OLI, freeze/pause/complete, verify data on Complete + All Call Schedule + Priority + Dashboard fallback. STORAGE_KEY is 'oli-live-work-v5'. Demo user Abhik Datta is hardcoded.
